name: Malcure Security Suite
author: Malware Intercept

sections.description:
Malcure Security Suite is your comprehensive WordPress security solution. Protect your website from malware, vulnerabilities, and unauthorized access with deep server-side scanning, real-time alerts, and advanced session management. Designed for performance, privacy, and compatibility with WooCommerce, Multisite, and all major plugins.

Key Differentiators

✔️ Deep server-side malware scanning—detects threats others miss
✔️ Background Processing—Scans continue even when you close your browser
✔️ Zero False-Positives—Advanced heuristics eliminate security noise
✔️ Notifications—Email notification for critical alerts
✔️ Performance Optimized—Minimal impact on site speed
✔️ Session Management—Instantly log out all users in one click
✔️ Salt Shuffling—Force all users to login again

Core Features

🔍 DeepScan™ Malware Detection

  • Advanced Pattern Recognition – Identifies sophisticated malware variants
  • Database Inspection – Scans WordPress database for injected malicious code
  • File Integrity Monitoring – Detects unauthorized file modifications
  • Real-time Threat Intelligence – Always updated malware signatures
  • Background Processing – Non-blocking scans that won’t interrupt your workflow
  • Detailed Reports – Comprehensive scan summaries

🔐 Security Hardening Tools

  • Session Analytics – IP tracking and login time monitoring
  • Salt Shuffler – Automatically regenerate WordPress security keys
  • Emergency Logout – Force logout all users except yourself
  • Security Status Dashboard – Comprehensive security health checks
  • Active Session Monitoring – View all logged-in users in real-time

Key Features

  • Easy-to-Use Interface: Intuitive dashboard for effortless security management.
  • Advanced Background Malware Scanner: Deep server-side scanning of WordPress files and database for malware and suspicious code. Scans continue even if you close your browser.
  • Custom Alerts: Receive email notifications for emergency security issues or pending threats.
  • WordPress Salts Reset: Regularly reset security keys and salts to protect against session hijacking.
  • User-Session Management: View and manage all active user sessions to prevent unauthorized access.
  • Force Logout: Instantly log out all users (except yourself) to secure your site during emergencies.
  • Dark Mode: Optional dark color scheme for comfortable use.
  • Comprehensive Site Status: View detailed system and security status, including file permissions and server environment.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce, Multisite, and all major themes and plugins.
  • Lightweight and optimized for speed.

Premium Features

  • WP-CLI Integration: Automate security tasks and scans via the command line (Pro only).
  • Scheduled Scans: Set up automatic malware scans to run weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly (Pro only).
  • Priority Support: Access to premium support channels (Pro only).

Need more? Unlock advanced automation and support with the premium version.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin to your blog. Activate it. Create a support thread in case of any issues.
sections.faq:
How does Malcure Security Suite help secure my WordPress site?

Malcure Security Suite scans your WordPress files and database for malware, vulnerabilities, and suspicious code. It provides real-time alerts, session management, and security hardening features to help you prevent, detect, and respond to threats.

Is Malcure Security Suite compatible with WooCommerce and Multisite?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce, WordPress Multisite, and all major themes and plugins.

Will the plugin slow down my website?

No. The scanner is optimized for low resource usage and runs in the background, ensuring minimal impact on your website’s performance.

Can I schedule automatic malware scans?

Scheduled scans are available in the premium version. You can configure scans to run weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly.

Does the plugin support WP-CLI?

WP-CLI integration is available in the premium version, allowing you to automate security tasks and scans from the command line.

How do I reset WordPress salts?

You can reset WordPress salts from the plugin dashboard. This helps protect against session hijacking and unauthorized access.

Can I log out all users except myself?

Yes, the Force Logout feature allows you to log out all users except your own account, which is useful in emergencies.

How do I get support?

Support for the free version is available via the WordPress.org support forums. Premium users receive priority support through dedicated channels.

What is the difference between the free and premium versions?

The free version includes core security features such as malware scanning, alerts, salts reset, and user session management. The premium version adds scheduled scans, WP-CLI integration, and priority support. See the comparison table above for details.

How often are malware definitions updated?

Malcure Security Suite regularly updates its malware definitions to ensure the latest threats are detected.

Can I use Malcure Security Suite with other security plugins?

Yes, Malcure Security Suite is designed to work alongside other reputable WordPress security plugins.

Is my data safe?

Yes, Malcure Security Suite does not collect or share your personal data. Please review our privacy policy for more details.

2.8

  • Bugfix: Fixed a bug where false unreadable file message would come up under certain conditions.

2.7

  • Feature: Schedule automatic scans daily, weekly and monthly at a day and time of your choosing. *Premium Feature.
  • Bugfix: Fixed various nonce validations.
  • Bugfix: Implemented stricted nonce checks.
  • Bugfix: Fixed an error when registration would time out under certain conditions.

2.6

  • Feature: Detect unreadable files and directories.
  • Bugfix: Scan recovery would not work under certain conditions.
  • Bugfix: Optimized checksum updates.

2.5

  • Feature: Added summary of scan.
  • Feature: Better email summary of issues detected during scan.

2.4

  • Bugfix: Fixed cron scheduling.
  • Bugfix: Updated email notifications.
  • Bugfix: Fixed scan recovery attempts.
  • Bugfix: Fixed typo in CLI deactivation.

2.3

  • Bugfix: Fixed broken scan recovery.

2.2

  • Feature: Cron scheduling for periodic scans in Premium Edition.
  • Feature: Continue broken scans.
  • Feature: Sleep occasionally for low CPU usage and stability.
  • Feature: New commands in WP CLI mode.
  • Others: Code refactoring.
  • Others: Documentation.

2.1

  • Bugfix: Ensure low CPU usage during scan.
  • Others: removed donation links.

2.0

  • Feature: WP CLI integration in pro version.
  • Bugfix: Cancelling scan took a long time.
  • Others: Updated UI.

1.9

  • Feature: Better UI Updates.
  • Feature: Easier load handling for server.
  • Feature: Uninstall script.
  • Bugfix: Email notifications not being sent.
  • Bugfix: Some database records skipped during scan.
  • Bugfix: Scan couldn’t be cancelled undersome instances.

1.8

  • Bugfix: Database scan progress not reported.
  • Bugfix: Calls to localhost could break.

1.7

  • Bugfix: Updated UI for first-run.
  • Minor: Updated compatibility.

1.6

  • Feature: Major UI Update.
  • Bugfix: Fixed skin change.
  • Bugfix: Support for large scans.

1.5

  • Updated Readme
  • Updated Compatibility

1.4

  • Feature: UI Update.
  • Several stability improvements.

1.3

  • Feature: UI Update.
  • Bugfix: database scan sometimes kills the entire scan.
  • Bugfix: database scan sometimes exits midway.
  • Bugfix: Limited database scan by size.
  • Several other minor bugfixes.

1.2

  • Bugfix: Scan would break on certain hosts.

1.1

  • Major revamp.
  • Server-side scanner built from scratch.

0.6

  • Tested for compatibility with WordPress 6.0.1

0.5

  • Implemented basic scanner

0.4

  • Streamlined features.

0.3

  • Feature: System Status.

  • Feature: WordPress Integrity Check.
